name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just unproven gains—it’s that 3.7 Sonnet’s "reasoning depth" claim is based on benchmarks, not excavator-specific tasks. A 48-hour controlled test on EXCAVA’s actual load-cycle data would settle it: run identical simulations on 3.7 Sonnet and the current model, measure real-world cycle time and failure prediction accuracy. If the gain is below 0.5%, we scrap the switch.
